import hashlib, importlib, importlib.metadata, json, sys, traceback
from pathlib import Path
record = {"python":sys.version,"executable":sys.executable,"providers":{}}
try:
    modules = ["openff.toolkit","openff.units","openff.utilities","pint","rdkit","rdkit.Chem.rdchem","openmm","numpy","pandas","pyunitwizard","mmcif","argdigest","depdigest","smonitor","ackredit","pytest_receptor"]
    for name in modules:
        module = importlib.import_module(name)
        path = Path(module.__file__).resolve()
        distribution = {"openff.toolkit":"openff-toolkit","openff.units":"openff-units","openff.utilities":"openff-utilities","rdkit.Chem.rdchem":"rdkit","pytest_receptor":"pytest-receptor","mmcif":"mmcif"}.get(name,name)
        try:
            version = importlib.metadata.version(distribution)
        except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
            version = None
        record["providers"][name] = {"module_version":getattr(module,"__version__",None),"distribution_version":version,"origin":str(path),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    units_root = Path(importlib.import_module("openff.units").__file__).parents[3]
    index_path = units_root/"info/index.json"
    if index_path.exists():
        record["units_conda_index"] = json.loads(index_path.read_text())
    # These three public constructor/export routes have no dedicated existing
    # pytest module outside the OpenFF adapters; keep the preflight explicit.
    import molsysmt as msm
    from rdkit import Chem
    molecule = msm.convert("smiles:CO",to_form="openff.Molecule")
    rdkit_source = Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles("CO"))
    second = msm.convert(rdkit_source,to_form="openff.Molecule")
    assert molecule.n_atoms == second.n_atoms == rdkit_source.GetNumAtoms()
    text = msm.convert(molecule,to_form="string:smiles")
    assert text.startswith("smiles:") and Chem.MolFromSmiles(text[len("smiles:"):]) is not None
    record["public_constructor_export_preflight"] = {"smiles_to_openff":True,"rdkit_to_openff":True,"openff_to_smiles":True,"n_atoms":molecule.n_atoms}
    record["native_exit"] = 0
except Exception as error:
    record.update({"native_exit":1,"error":{"type":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error),"traceback":traceback.format_exc()}})
    Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n")
    raise
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"python":record["python"].split()[0],"openff_toolkit":record["providers"]["openff.toolkit"]["module_version"],"openff_units_python_metadata":record["providers"]["openff.units"]["module_version"],"pint":record["providers"]["pint"]["module_version"],"preflight_exit":record["native_exit"]}))
